_comment: MOCK DATA (AYWC-183 preview). Nothing in Discourse has been created yet, so these entries carry only a reply count and deliberately NO topic id. Without an id the link falls back to the forum home. Do not invent ids: Discourse resolves /t/slug/ID by the number and ignores the slug, so a made-up id silently lands on whatever real topic holds it. When the real Seed Thought topics exist, add "id" and "slug" per day and the links resolve properly.
